name: Human Realm
subtitle: Ruler: Ruby Divina (Female)
description: The realm of humanity. It has a large population, likely in the hundreds of thousands, which is part of why only having 7 Healers at any given time is considered so rare and significant. The Arubian Forest, the light half of the Ether Forest, lies within it, along with its own ruler, Ruby Divina.

name: Angel Realm
subtitle: Ruler: Clint Ashborn (Male, Serapharch)
description: The home of the angels. The Lumen, the lowest-ranking angels, are its citizens and almost never leave it. Lethmoor, a fallen kingdom recorded in this realm, was later replicated inside the Hidden Realm. Ruled by Clint Ashborn, a Serapharch.

fields.label: Inhabitants
fields.value: All four angel ranks — Serapharch, Aetherblade Lord, Virtue, Lumen

name: Demon Realm
subtitle: Ruler: Tera Morage (Female, Mordrach)
description: The home of the demons, ruled by Tera Morage, a Mordrach. The Umbrage Forest, the dark half of the Ether Forest, is located here, where all the hostile monsters stay.

name: Hidden Realm (Shadow Realm)
subtitle: An artificial realm between all the others
description: An artificially created realm where time is slowed down by 10 times and you do not feel hungry or get tired easily. It was made by an old race that was killed off by the former Human Realm ruler, built as a form of escape. Some managed to escape, but the forceful creation of the realm nearly destroyed the whole world — so, along with drawing power from the untouched world core, the world barrier was made to split the world and stop the destruction. In the newly made realm all sorts of creatures began to form, and since the survivors did not know how to hunt them down, all of them died except the Head Master of the academy.

fields.label: The portal
fields.value: The portal forms by drawing in all the Veyn from its surroundings until the area is fully drained, then uses what it absorbed to relocate somewhere new that is rich in Veyn. It takes roughly a leap year for enough Veyn to concentrate, which is why the portal only reappears that often. Someone with a strong enough sense of Veyn density could theoretically predict where it will appear next.

fields.label: Time
fields.value: Time is slowed down by 10 times — you do not feel hungry or get tired easily.

fields.label: Creator
fields.value: Made by an old race, later killed off by the former Human Realm ruler, as a form of escape.

fields.label: Location
fields.value: In between all the other realms.

fields.label: Notable places
fields.value: Thornlost Forest, Sentient River, Lethmoor Kingdom

name: Ether Forest
subtitle: A forest grouped into two parts
description: A forest that is grouped into two parts. The light area is still visible with daylight and is where some neutral monsters stay. The two halves are the Arubian Forest and the Umbrage Forest.

name: Arubian Forest
subtitle: The light half of the forest — Human Realm
description: The light half of the forest, located within the Human Realm, where some neutral monsters stay. Fairies roam here and can help you find treasures hidden in the forest for a valuable trade. The Pallantine Elves make their home here, and Griffens are used as their transport.

fields.label: Inhabitants
fields.value: Fairies, Pallantine Elves, Griffens, neutral monsters

name: Umbrage Forest
subtitle: The dark half of the forest — Demon Realm
description: The dark half of the forest, located within the Demon Realm, where all the hostile monsters stay. Trolls, Minotaurs, Harpies and Veilborn Elves live here. At the beginning of the story, the portal to the Hidden Realm is located here.

fields.label: Inhabitants
fields.value: Trolls, Minotaurs, Harpies, Veilborn Elves, other hostile monsters

name: Thornlost Forest
subtitle: The guarded forest of the Hidden Realm
description: A forest in the Hidden Realm. It is guarded by the Coilmane, the forest guardian with a snake tail and lion body.

name: Sentient River
subtitle: The living river of the Shadow Realm
description: The river where the Sirens make their home in the Shadow Realm. The river is aware and does not take kindly to being disturbed — the water reacts to intent, calm for those who pass by but violent and resistant toward anyone who tries to take something from it, especially the thing sealed in its depths. Currents shift on their own, pulling and dragging with a will rather than gravity, and it is said the river can sense a person’s purpose the moment they touch it. Combined with the hypnotic song of the Sirens, the river is an active participant in keeping Vireth, the Fallen Grace, buried.

fields.label: Danger
fields.value: The river itself reacts violently to those who come looking for the wrong reasons; Sirens hypnotize anyone who hears them sing.

fields.label: Sealed within
fields.value: Vireth, the Fallen Grace — held down by two separate seals.

name: The Sundering Altar
subtitle: Where every person’s Veyn awakens at age 15
description: At 15, every person in the world is brought to the Sundering Altar, where their latent connection to Veyn is unlocked for the first time. Before this, no one — human, elf, angel, demon — can consciously access magic. The altar does not teach them to use it; it simply opens the channel. The moment Veyn awakens, it manifests visibly in a way that reveals their affinity: the specific path or discipline they are suited to (combat-magic, healing, elemental control, beast-bonding, etc.). This is not a conscious choice; it is revealed based on what is already latent inside them, which is why it works as an “awakening” rather than a “selection.” Path-choosing comes after, once someone knows their affinity, they then choose how to pursue it (which order, mentor, discipline, or role to commit to).

name: Lethmoor Kingdom
subtitle: A replicated fallen kingdom in the Hidden Realm
description: A kingdom in the Hidden Realm surrounded by lava, with surrounding terrain of unstable Veyn which is dangerous. You can pass safely if you have the Iron-will Ring, though you will not be safe for a long time. It is guarded by the Leviathan, and at the throne room sits the Cindergrave Wraith Lord. It is a replicated city gotten from a recorded fallen kingdom in the Angel Realm. Since the kingdom is replicated, there are treasures too, found in the chamber beneath the throne chair.

fields.label: Treasure vault
fields.value: Chamber beneath the throne chair — Aerendrel, Liework’s Fallen Crown, Rejuvenating Elixir, Sael’s Luck

name: Pixies
subtitle: Small dust-makers of the Hidden Realm
description: They are smaller than Fairies. They produce “pixie dust” which can be used to make a potion. They stay in the Hidden Realm. Pixie dust can make someone younger or give a permanent boost in Veyn and a little for Ren.

name: Fairies
subtitle: Friendly treasure-finders of the Arubian Forest
description: They are friendly creatures that roam in the Arubian Forest. They can help you find treasures that may be hidden in the forest for a valuable trade.

name: Trolls
subtitle: Group hunters of the Umbrage Forest
description: They stay at the darker side of the Arubian Forest (the Umbrage Forest). They always move in groups.

name: Minotaur
subtitle: Human-hostile beasts of the Umbrage Forest
description: They stay in the Umbrage Forest and are aggressive towards humans.

name: Elves
subtitle: Territorial forest folk — two types
description: They stay in the Arubian Forest or the Umbrage Forest, and become aggressive to those who destroy the part of the forest in their territory. There are two types of Elves: the Pallantine and the Veilborn.

fields.label: Pallantine
fields.value: They stay in the Arubian Forest.

fields.label: Veilborn
fields.value: They stay in the Umbrage Forest and only trust themselves.

name: Griffen
subtitle: The Pallantine’s mountain transport
description: They are used as transport by the Pallantine. They live on the highest part of mountains.

name: Coilmane
subtitle: Guardian of the Thornlost Forest
description: They have a snake as a tail which uses a powerful venom, and a lion as the main body, and they have a strong skin which is great for defense. It is the guardian of the forest in the Hidden Realm called Thornlost Forest.

fields.label: Notable
fields.value: Its venom is one of the few things that can wound an Aetherblade Lord Angel fatally.

name: Harpies
subtitle: Shapeshifting winged beasts of the Umbrage Forest
description: They use a fiery whip as a weapon in combat and they can shapeshift; they are shapeshifting winged beasts. They stay in the Umbrage Forest.

name: Dragons
subtitle: Territorial guardians of the Shadow Realm
description: They stay in the Shadow Realm. They are very protective of their territory. They can also be found on high mountain tops in the Hidden Realm, where they become hostile to anyone who invades their territory. They are very difficult to deal with due to their tough scales and slightly strong magic resistance. Kaelroot trees grow near the nest of a dragon.

fields.label: Location
fields.value: Shadow Realm; high mountain tops in the Hidden Realm

fields.label: Notable
fields.value: Their heart is an ingredient in the Ethereal Potion.

name: Sirens
subtitle: Hypnotic humanoid fish-women
description: They are humanoid fish women. They stay in the Sentient River in the Shadow Realm. They can hypnotize you when you hear them sing.

name: Shudon
subtitle: The stone golem guardians of the realm entrances
description: They are highly intelligent stone golems that are skilled in combat. They are made from the core of the world to protect the realms from collapse. Though they have been inactive for a long time. All the entrances to the different realms are guarded by a Shudon.

fields.label: Status
fields.value: Inactive for a long time; no one currently knows how to reactivate them.

fields.label: Plot
fields.value: They become active later in the story.

name: The Wanderer
subtitle: Immortal seller of rare artifacts
description: A mysterious creature who walks between Realms but mainly stays in the Hidden Realm. It sells artifacts that can’t be seen anywhere. It is an immortal being not bound to one realm.

fields.label: What they sell
fields.value: Wraithcloth, Ring of Foundation, Remy’s Bracelet, Hermes Robe, Iron-will Ring

name: Leviathan
subtitle: The lava-adapted sea serpent of Lethmoor
description: A massive sea-serpent by nature, not something born of fire or lava, but forced to adapt after being drawn into Lethmoor’s territory by its unstable Veyn. Its scales have hardened and darkened over time, taking on a scorched, obsidian-like sheen to withstand the heat, and what was likely once a creature built for deep water now moves through lava the way its kind would normally move through the sea. It surfaces to guard the approach to the kingdom, and its sheer size and adapted resilience to heat make it one of the first real obstacles anyone has to survive before ever reaching the ruins themselves.

name: Cindergrave Wraith Lord
subtitle: Ruler of Lethmoor’s ruins
description: The ruler of Lethmoor’s ruins, formed from the strongest fragment of will pulled from the fallen kingdom when the city was replicated. It is not a dead body turned undead; it is an unfinished will given shape by the unstable Veyn in Lethmoor’s terrain. It hungers for Veyn from anything living that enters the ruins, and feeding is what keeps its half-replicated form from falling apart. It rules from the throne room but can move through the ruins to rally the lesser Cindergrave wraiths if intruders get deep enough. Its touch drains Veyn directly from a target to sustain itself — the more it feeds, the stronger and more solid it gets before fading back down. Destroying it means disrupting the Veyn holding it together, not just physical damage, so a Diviner or Exorcist hits it far harder than a regular weapon would.

name: Lesser Cindergrave Wraiths
subtitle: Drifting fragments of will
description: Weaker fragments of will formed the same way the Cindergrave Wraith Lord was, pulled from the fallen kingdom when Lethmoor was replicated, just without enough strength or Veyn to hold a fully solid form. They drift through the ruins and only fully mobilize when the Cindergrave Wraith Lord rallies them against intruders who get too deep into the city. Like their lord, they feed on Veyn from the living to stay together, though far less efficiently. A lesser Cindergrave wraith can be worn down and dispersed by regular weapons; they just reform again over time as long as Lethmoor’s unstable Veyn remains in the terrain.

name: The Seer
subtitle: The keeper of the next Healer’s identity
description: One person in the Human Realm knows who the next Healer will be; this role is called The Seer. The Seer is entrusted with a gem known as The Truthstone which has the power to locate who the new Healer is. The Seer is the only one who knows the gem’s location.

name: Angels (Overview)
subtitle: Four ranks, wings and halos tell the rank
description: There are four ranks of angels: Serapharch, Aetherblade Lord Angel, Virtue, and Lumen. They have pure white feathery wings and a glowing halo on top of their heads. The number of wings indicates their rank — the higher the rank, the more wings they have. The appearance of their halo also changes slightly by rank: the higher the rank, the more powerful and bright they look; lower-rank halos glow very dimly. They have an angelic aura around them all the time, and the stronger the aura, the stronger they are.

fields.label: Note
fields.value: Both demons and angels can retract or hide their wings if they want.

fields.label: Note
fields.value: Abilities learnt can be passed down to offspring, though not all the time.

name: Serapharch
subtitle: Rank 1 — Ruler of the Angel Realm
description: The ruler of the Angel Realm. They are essentially immortal and can only be killed by A Corrupted Divine Weapon (Vireth, the Fallen Grace) or A Divine Weapon. They have a very strong regenerative ability and a very strong natural defense.

fields.label: Appearance
fields.value: 8 wings, large and almost covering their whole body, the feathers glow gold. Their halo is a solid ring of light, too bright to look at directly. They have the strongest aura among all the angels. Their wing color is light pale gold with a bright but dim glow.

fields.label: Skills
fields.value: Kings Record, Sixth Sense, Time Reversal, Chronos Fury, Will Mastery, Holy Rain, Dignified Presence, Angelic Aura (Serapharch), Holy Flame, God’s Index Finger, God Chain, Holy Grail, Warpstep, Dawnveil (Serapharch) — each skill has its own entry in the Angel Skills / Demon Skills categories.

name: Aetherblade Lord Angel
subtitle: Rank 2 — Commander of the Angel Army
description: A high-ranking angel and commander of the angel army, answering only to the Serapharch. They never age and are nearly impossible to bring down in battle through conventional means. Only a consecrated weapon, a blood-forged blade, or the venom of a Coilmane carries enough power to wound them fatally. Their regeneration works on Veyn — if there is Veyn in their body they can heal.

fields.label: Appearance
fields.value: 6 wings, big but with scars from battle that never fully heal. Their halo is bright but steady, not as dazzling as the Serapharch’s. They look more like warriors, with sharper features and always in a battle-ready stance. Their aura is strong but not too strong, though they can improve it. Their wings are pure white and they glow.

fields.label: Skills
fields.value: Skyward Chains, Vanguard’s Cry, Aegis Ward, Holy Mend, Angelic Aura (Aetherblade), Swiftstep, Dawnveil (Aetherblade) — each skill has its own entry in the Angel Skills / Demon Skills categories.

name: Virtue
subtitle: Rank 3 — Soldiers of the Angel Army
description: A mid-ranking angel with regenerative ability lesser than the Aetherblade Lord Angel. They serve as soldiers under the Aetherblade Lord Angel, forming the disciplined core of the angel army. Unlike Aetherblade Lord Angels above them, a Virtue can be killed by conventional blessed or consecrated weapons — they do not require a Divine Weapon or blood-forged blade. Though their regeneration is weaker, if they have stamina they can heal. Their healing cannot work with Veyn.

fields.label: Appearance
fields.value: 4 wings, smaller and duller than the ranks above them. Their halo flickers instead of staying solid. Their aura is just normal. They have cream colored wings.

fields.label: Skills
fields.value: Guiding Light, Radiant Strike, Formation Discipline, Angelic Aura (Virtue), Dawnveil (Virtue) — each skill has its own entry in the Angel Skills / Demon Skills categories.

fields.label: Can be killed by
fields.value: Conventional blessed or consecrated weapons — a holy blessed weapon or a contaminated holy blessed weapon.

name: Lumen
subtitle: Rank 4 — Citizens of the Angel Realm
description: They can be killed with regular weapons. They are the citizens of the Angel Realm, they don’t have regenerative abilities and are weak. They always stay in the Angel Realm, and only leave if they need something outside their realm.

fields.label: Appearance
fields.value: 2 wings, small and delicate. Their halo is faint, barely visible. Their aura is the weakest. They have light gray colored wings.

fields.label: Skills
fields.value: Warmth of the Realm, Faint Ward, Angelic Aura (Lumen), Dawnveil (Lumen) — each skill has its own entry in the Angel Skills / Demon Skills categories.

name: Fallen Angel
subtitle: Cast out — broken halo, spotted wings
description: They have black spotted white wings or black cherry spotted white wings and a broken halo on top of their head. Once the vow breaks, the angel is cast out of the Angel Realm and rejected by their own race — this is what makes them a Fallen Angel. They keep their wings and whatever power they had, but can never take another Veyn Vow again, so their connection to Veyn stays unstable and unregulated. This makes them strong in bursts but dangerous even to themselves, since nothing filters how much Veyn moves through them anymore.

fields.label: Cause
fields.value: Breaking the Angel Veyn Vow (disobeying someone above their rank, or pulling more Veyn than the vow allows to act against an order).

fields.label: Markings
fields.value: Plain black spots or black cherry spotting depending on how much Veyn surged through when the vow broke.

name: The Angel Veyn Vow
subtitle: The magical bond that regulates angelic Veyn
description: Every angel takes a Veyn Vow when their halo first forms. It binds their access to Veyn to their obedience to the angelic hierarchy. It is not just spoken, it is a magical bond — the halo is the physical seal of it. If the vow holds, an angel can freely use Veyn within their rank’s limit, and the halo regulates it so it doesn’t overwhelm them. The vow is the reason angels can hold as much power as they do; without it their body can’t safely filter raw Veyn on its own. Rank affects the vow too — a higher rank means a stronger vow and halo, so they can channel more Veyn without breaking. The vow breaks when an angel disobeys someone above their rank or pulls more Veyn than their vow allows to act against an order. Once it breaks, the halo can’t hold the channel steady and shatters, becoming the broken halo Fallen Angels are known for. The wings get affected too — the uncontrolled Veyn surging through them leaves permanent black spotting on the feathers.

fields.label: Halo
fields.value: An angel’s halo forms at age 15, when the vow is taken at the altar.

name: Demons (Overview)
subtitle: Four ranks, horns and wings tell the rank
description: There are four ranks of demons: Mordrach, Bloodward, Scourge, and Gnash. They have horns on their forehead and feathery black wings. The number of horns and wings both indicate their rank — the higher the rank, the more horns and wings they have. They always have a demonic aura around them. Note: a rank can be passed down to an offspring, though not all the time, so they would have to work their way up the ranks.

fields.label: Note
fields.value: Both demons and angels can retract or hide their wings if they want.

fields.label: Duskveil
fields.value: Innate to all demons. Lets them blend into any society, hiding their true form and aura. The higher the rank, the more effective the disguise and the less power it costs; the lower the rank, the weaker the disguise and the more it cuts into their true strength.

name: Mordrach
subtitle: Rank 1 — Rulers of the Demon Realm
description: They are the rulers of the Demon Realm and the highest rank of authority there. They can’t be killed by regular weapons or holy imbued weapons. They can only be harmed and killed by a Divine weapon.

fields.label: Appearance
fields.value: 8 horns and 8 wings, the horns curling back and fused together at the base like a crown. Their wings are massive, tattered at the edges but still powerful, the black feathers seeming to absorb light rather than reflect it. They have the strongest aura amongst all the demons. Deep-purple colored wings.

fields.label: Skills
fields.value: Death Scythe, Chain Reaper Scythe, Call of the Dead, Dominating Will, Soul Oath, Veyn Decomposition (Mordrach), Hands of Death, Purgatory Flames, Charm, Soul-Sight, Berserk (Mordrach), Demonic Aura (Mordrach), Duskveil (Mordrach) — each skill has its own entry in the Angel Skills / Demon Skills categories.

fields.label: Known Mordrach
fields.value: Tera Morage (Female) — current ruler of the Demon Realm.

name: Bloodward
subtitle: Rank 2 — Commanders of the Demon Army
description: They are the commanders of the Demon army in the Demon Realm. Their regenerative ability is less than the Mordrach, and their regenerative ability runs on Veyn.

fields.label: Appearance
fields.value: 6 horns and 6 wings, the horns sharp and jagged, some cracked from old battles. Their wings are broad and scarred, mirroring how the Aetherblade Lord Angel’s wings carry battle-scars that never fully heal. They carry themselves like commanders, always poised for a fight. Their aura is strong but not too strong like the Mordrach. Dark, purple colored wings.

fields.label: Skills
fields.value: Blood Chains, Warcry of Dominion, Crimson Ward, Blood Pact, Veyn Decomposition (Bloodward), Demonic Aura (Bloodward), Berserk (Bloodward), Duskveil (Bloodward) — each skill has its own entry in the Angel Skills / Demon Skills categories.

name: Scourge
subtitle: Rank 3 — Demon Soldiers
description: They are demon soldiers that are under the Bloodward. They have a lesser regeneration that runs on Vitality.

fields.label: Appearance
fields.value: 4 horns and 4 wings, shorter and less refined than the ranks above. Their wings are smaller, feathers rougher and less full. Their aura is just normal. Wine purple colored wings.

fields.label: Skills
fields.value: Vitality Surge, Rend Claws, Pack Tactics, Veyn Decomposition (Scourge), Berserk (Scourge), Demonic Aura (Scourge), Duskveil (Scourge) — each skill has its own entry in the Angel Skills / Demon Skills categories.

name: Gnash
subtitle: Rank 4 — Regular Demons
description: They are regular demons. At the age of 15 they are taken to The Sundering Altar for their awakening. They can make contracts with anyone, and once the contract is signed, they are bound by it and can’t break free from it until it has been fulfilled. Making a contract with a Gnash is very risky since most of the time they are not friendly, and they want to increase their rank for more power.

fields.label: Appearance
fields.value: 2 horns and 2 wings, small and stubby, barely more than bumps. Their wings are the smallest of all demon ranks, thin and often kept retracted. They look the most human out of all the ranks, which fits since they’re the ones taken to the Sundering Altar and still closest to an ordinary life before their power grows. Their aura is the weakest and gives an ominous feeling. Mauve, purple colored wings.

fields.label: Skills
fields.value: Binding Contract, Veyn Decomposition (Gnash), Instinctive Bargaining, Demonic Aura (Gnash), Duskveil (Gnash) — each skill has its own entry in the Angel Skills / Demon Skills categories.

name: Duskveil
subtitle: The innate demonic disguise
description: Innate to all demons. Lets them blend into any society, hiding their true form and aura. The higher the rank, the more effective the disguise and the less power it costs to maintain; the lower the rank, the weaker the disguise and the more it cuts into their true strength.

fields.label: Mordrach
fields.value: Can pass flawlessly, even under scrutiny. Cuts their true strength by half while active.

fields.label: Bloodward
fields.value: Holds up well, though subtle tells (eyes, a shadow at the wrong angle) could give them away under close or magical scrutiny. Cuts their true strength by roughly 60%.

fields.label: Scourge
fields.value: Rougher and less convincing, more likely to slip under stress or in combat. Cuts their true strength by roughly 70%.

fields.label: Gnash
fields.value: The weakest version, thin enough to break under any real scrutiny. Cuts their true strength by roughly 80%, though since Gnash already look close to human naturally, they rely on it the least.

name: Humans
subtitle: The versatile race — affinity can change
description: Unlike other races, humans aren’t locked into one Veyn affinity for life. When an elf, angel, or demon is revealed at the altar, that affinity stays fixed forever, but a human’s affinity can change or grow over time through training. This means a human could eventually learn more than one affinity, something no other race can do. The catch is that switching or adding a new affinity is extremely hard. Most humans try and give up, choosing to stick with the one affinity they got at the altar instead. Even the ones who succeed never become as powerful in any single affinity as a race built specifically for it — they trade raw power for versatility. Humans can also learn all the skills of their chosen class, while other races are limited to 5.

name: Healers
subtitle: The seven healers of the Human Realm
description: There are only seven healers in the Human Realm. When one dies, a new healer is chosen within the next two years. Anyone can train as a Healer, though only seven at a time hold the actual title in the Human Realm. One person in the Human Realm knows who the next healer will be — this role is called The Seer.

fields.label: Role
fields.value: Anyone can train as a Healer; only seven at a time hold the title in the Human Realm.

name: The Truthstone
subtitle: The gem that locates the next Healer
description: A gem entrusted to The Seer. It has the power to locate who the new Healer is. The Seer is the only one who knows the gem’s location.

name: Veyn
subtitle: The ambient magic of the world
description: It is what allows people to use magic in the world. It is drawn from the core of the world and everything around us. Veyn naturally glows a pale silver-blue, like faint moonlight. This is its raw, neutral form before it’s shaped into something else. Holy energy brightens it into gold, while corrupted Veyn (like a demon’s miasma) darkens it into deep purple or black.

fields.label: Source
fields.value: Drawn from the core of the world and everything around us.

fields.label: Color
fields.value: Naturally glows pale silver-blue like faint moonlight; holy energy brightens it into gold, while corrupted Veyn (like a demon’s miasma) darkens it into deep purple or black.

name: Ren
subtitle: The inner energy of swordsmen
description: It is what swordsmen use in place of Veyn. It is the inner energy from our body brought out to enhance our strength. Ren glows a deep crimson red since it is drawn from a person’s own Vitality rather than an outside source. Where Veyn feels cool and ambient, Ren feels warm and physical, more like a pulse than a light.

fields.label: Feel
fields.value: Warm and physical, like a pulse.

fields.label: Vitality
fields.value: Ren is drawn from a person’s own Vitality — their life energy.

name: Concentrated Veyn
subtitle: Brighter, denser Veyn
description: Matches the color of a Lucent Stone: the same silver-blue as raw Veyn, just far brighter and more vivid, clear rather than faint or hazy.

fields.label: Color
fields.value: Same silver-blue as raw Veyn, just far brighter and more vivid — clear rather than faint or hazy.

name: Saturation Sickness
subtitle: The cost of lingering in concentrated Veyn
description: Caused by staying near or within concentrated Veyn for too long. The body can’t regulate the overwhelming amount of ambient Veyn, causing a person’s own Veyn to leak out constantly rather than being properly contained. This leaves them unable to perform any real magic (at most just basic spells), along with constant weakness, vomiting, and excessive sleep as the body struggles against the imbalance.

fields.label: Cause
fields.value: Staying near or within concentrated Veyn for too long.

fields.label: Symptoms
fields.value: Constant weakness, vomiting, and excessive sleep; unable to perform any real magic (at most basic spells) as the body leaks its own Veyn.

name: Affinity & Awakening
subtitle: How Veyn affinity is revealed and chosen
description: At 15, every person is brought to the Sundering Altar where their latent connection to Veyn is unlocked — no one can consciously access magic before this. The altar doesn’t teach them to use it; it simply opens the channel. The moment Veyn awakens it manifests visibly in a way that reveals their affinity (combat-magic, healing, elemental control, beast-bonding, etc.). This is not a conscious choice in the moment; it is revealed based on what’s already latent inside them. Path-choosing comes after: once someone knows their affinity, they choose how to pursue it (which order, mentor, discipline, or role to commit to).

name: Class Skill Limits
subtitle: Humans can master a class fully; other races are capped
description: All races can use skills of their chosen class, but since the Angel and Demon realms have innate skills already, the max skills they can learn from their class is 5, while humans can learn all the skills of that class.

name: Veyn & Ren Incompatibility
subtitle: You can never hold both
description: Joining magic and Bladesinger is not possible since Veyn and Ren are not compatible; you can’t have Ren and Veyn together in your body since it can kill you due to their extreme incompatibility.

name: Growing Your Veyn Capacity
subtitle: How to increase your pool
description: The amount of Veyn someone can use from birth is already set. If you want to increase it, finish it (use it all up) and keep replenishing your Veyn for it to increase.

name: Inheritance of Ranks & Abilities
subtitle: Not always passed down
description: A rank can be passed down to an offspring, though not all the time — otherwise they would have to work their way up the ranks. Abilities learnt can also be passed down to your offspring, though not all the time.

name: The Hidden Realm Portal
subtitle: Moves every leap year
description: The portal to the Hidden Realm changes its location every leap year. It forms by drawing in all the Veyn from its surroundings until the area is fully drained, then uses what it absorbed to relocate itself somewhere new that’s rich in Veyn. The amount of time it takes for enough Veyn to concentrate in a new location happens to be roughly a leap year, which is why the portal only reappears that often. Since it’s drawn to wherever Veyn is rich rather than moving randomly, someone with a strong enough sense of Veyn density could theoretically predict roughly where it might appear next. All the entrances to the different realms are guarded by a Shudon.

name: Mage
subtitle: Magic/Veyn class
description: A general Veyn-caster with access to the widest range of spells out of any class. Not specialized in anything specific, they use raw Veyn for offense, defense, or utility depending on the situation.

name: Alchemist
subtitle: Magic/Veyn class
description: Combines Veyn with physical ingredients to make potions, poisons, or explosives. They can use pixie dust as one of their core ingredients since it reacts well with Veyn, though pixie dust is quite rare and can only be gotten by going to the Hidden Realm.

name: Beastmaster
subtitle: Ren class
description: Bonds with a living creature and fights alongside it in battle. The bond is built on trust, not force, so the creature must accept the bond for it to work.

name: Smithing
subtitle: Veyn & Ren class
description: Crafts weapons and armor using Veyn to reinforce or enchant them during the forging process. Blood-forging (using demon or angel blood in the forge) is one of the hardest skills in this class to learn — not every Smith can do it, since demon and angel blood is reactive to Veyn, and a mistake can cause the death of the smith.

fields.label: Blood-forging
fields.value: The rank of the demon or angel whose blood is used determines how powerful the weapon will be — low ranking blood can at least injure, high ranking blood can kill. Demon and angel blood is reactive to Veyn; a mistake can cause the death of the smith.

name: Enchanter
subtitle: Magic/Veyn class
description: Imbues ordinary items with Veyn, giving them lasting magical properties. Unlike Smithing, they do not make the item, they just enhance one that already exists.

name: Diviner
subtitle: Magic/Veyn class
description: Channels holy energy, the same purified Veyn that Holy Rain and Holy Flame are made from, to read fragments of the future or uncover hidden truths. A subtle, passive class — most Diviners are not fighters; they are consulted rather than deployed in battle. There are only 3 Diviners per century. They have the innate ability to see through any lies or disguises, called True-Sight.

fields.label: Innate ability
fields.value: True-Sight — see through any lies or disguises

fields.label: Only humans
fields.value: Only humans have ever been Diviners — there are only 3 in the world.

name: Exorcist
subtitle: Veyn-use class
description: Trained to deal with corrupted or unstable Veyn. This includes handling Fallen Angels or miasma contamination from demons. A dangerous but necessary profession.

name: Broker
subtitle: Ren class
description: A guild-regulated occupation that safely handles and mediates contracts, especially with Gnash demons. Going to a Gnash directly without one is considered risky.

name: Saintess
subtitle: Holy class
description: Unlike a Mage who draws on raw Veyn, a Saintess channels holy energy, the same energy Diviners, Holy Rain, and Holy Flame use. This makes her spells naturally effective against undead, miasma, and other corrupted Veyn, but weaker against things that have nothing to do with corruption. Her magic leans almost entirely toward healing, protection, and cleansing rather than direct offense.

name: Healer
subtitle: Magic/Veyn class
description: Trained in restoring injuries and health using Veyn. Anyone can train as a Healer, though only seven at a time hold the actual title in the Human Realm.

name: Archer
subtitle: Magic/Veyn class
description: Uses Veyn to enchant their arrows or shots, giving them extra effects like piercing, explosive, or homing properties.

name: Paladin
subtitle: Ren + Holy class
description: Blends physical strength with holy energy, giving them the fighting capability of a warrior alongside the ability to heal or protect using a Pure version of Veyn (holy energy). Common among those who protect others directly, like guards or knights.

name: Grimtender
subtitle: Magic/Veyn class
description: Reanimates and commands the remains of fallen creatures, using the residual Veyn still left in bones after death. The bigger or stronger the creature was in life, the more Veyn its bones hold, and the stronger the reanimated servant becomes.

name: Bladesinger
subtitle: Ren class
description: Refines Ren into precise, elegant swordplay. Focused on control and technique over raw power. Practically a swordsman.

name: Berserker
subtitle: Ren class
description: Burns Ren recklessly for a huge boost in power, at the cost of control and clear thinking.

name: Sentinel
subtitle: Ren class
description: Uses Ren purely for defense and endurance, built to hold a line rather than deal heavy damage.

name: Ren Archer
subtitle: Ren class
description: The Ren-based counterpart to Archer. No Veyn involved, just pure skill, precision, and physical technique.

name: Veilrunner
subtitle: Ren class
description: A stealth and infiltration class built on Ren, relying on trained instinct and body control to move unseen rather than any disguising magic.

name: Shudonkeeper
subtitle: Classless class
description: Studies and maintains the Shudon, the stone golems guarding the realm entrances. Since the Shudon have been inactive for a long time and no one currently knows how to reactivate them, this class has no real combat use yet — it exists purely to preserve and study what’s left of them until that changes.

name: Restoration Potion
subtitle: Restores Veyn
description: Can be brewed with Veyn stones to make a potion that restores the person’s Veyn.

name: Veyn Stone
subtitle: Condensed crystallized Veyn
description: A condensed version of Veyn that has been crystallized. Appearance: a rough, unpolished crystal, cloudy and slightly milky rather than clear, with a faint silver-blue glow visible just beneath the surface. It looks closer to a raw mineral pulled straight from the ground than a finished gem.

name: Lucent Stone
subtitle: The refined Veyn Stone
description: A refined form of a Veyn Stone, created by purifying the crystallized Veyn even further until it becomes clear and stable. Unlike a raw Veyn Stone, a Lucent Stone holds a much higher concentration of Veyn in a much smaller size, making it far more potent, but also far harder and more costly to produce. It’s used in stronger brews and enchantments where a regular Veyn Stone wouldn’t be enough; a single Lucent Stone can be worth several raw Veyn Stones combined. Appearance: clear and smooth, almost glass-like, with the silver-blue glow fully visible and much brighter.

name: Lucent Reserve
subtitle: Full restoration of Veyn or Ren
description: A potion made from the Lucent Stone; it can do a full restoration of the person’s either Veyn or Ren.

name: Healing Potion
subtitle: Heals minor injuries
description: A potion brewed to heal minor injuries and can partially heal serious injuries, though not fully or completely.

name: Wraithcloth
subtitle: Hide your presence and scent
description: Allows you to hide your presence and scent, which makes it difficult to detect you — though it can be seen through with a Diviner’s True-Sight.

name: Ring of Foundation
subtitle: Store and release Veyn
description: It is used to store any amount of Veyn and can be released back into the body to refresh the reserves of Veyn in the body.

name: Remy’s Bracelet
subtitle: Carry 10 items anywhere
description: Allows the user to store up to 10 items in the bracelet. To use, pour in your Veyn or Ren into the bracelet and think of the item you want to bring out and the item would come out; if you want to put in an item, think of the item already being inside the storage and the item would enter — all while using your Ren or Veyn to bring in or pull out items.

name: Hermes Robe
subtitle: 20x speed
description: It enhances your speed by 20 times.

name: Iron-will Ring
subtitle: Resist poison, mental attacks, and fatal injuries
description: Used to increase your resistance to poison, mental attacks, and fatal injuries. Though for the fatal injuries function, it has a year cooldown. It also has partial, though little, resistance to unstable Veyn and little resistance to the Sentient River current and pull. Required to pass safely through Lethmoor’s unstable Veyn terrain.

fields.label: Note
fields.value: Needed to pass safely through the unstable Veyn terrain around Lethmoor Kingdom.

name: Pixie Dust
subtitle: Youth, Veyn and Ren in a powder
description: Can be used to make someone younger or give a permanent boost in Veyn and a little for Ren. It is one of the core ingredients of the Alchemist class, since it reacts well with Veyn. It is quite rare and can only be gotten by going to the Hidden Realm. It can be brewed with pixie dust, grinded leaves of the Grimbough tree, grinded powder from the bark of the Kaelroot tree, and the heart of a dragon — the resulting potion is called the Ethereal Potion.

name: Grimbough Tree
subtitle: The magic-resistant slanting tree
description: It is a slanting tree. Its wood is thick and strong, with a strong resistance to magic. The leaves are thin and can be grinded into dust to be used for the brewing of the Ethereal Potion.

name: Kaelroot Tree
subtitle: The 100-year tree of dragon nests
description: It is found and grows near the nest of a dragon. It is a 100-year-old tree. The leaves can be used to make an elixir named the Rejuvenating Elixir, while the bark when grinded to powder can be used in making the Ethereal Potion.

name: Ethereal Potion
subtitle: Legendary-rank elixir that halts aging
description: A legendary-rank elixir, difficult to brew correctly — a single miscalculation wastes the rare ingredients entirely. Rather than restoring or boosting Veyn or Ren, it halts the drinker’s aging completely for a long, fixed stretch of time rather than reversing it like pixie dust does.

fields.label: Ingredients
fields.value: Pixie dust, grinded leaves of the Grimbough tree, grinded powder from the bark of the Kaelroot tree, the heart of a dragon

name: Rejuvenating Elixir
subtitle: Complete healing
description: A potion that does a complete heal of the person who drinks it. Can even heal broken legs or lost arms. The version found in the vault of Lethmoor can heal the impossible, except a severed head or a missing heart past 10 minutes.

name: Vireth, the Fallen Grace
subtitle: The corrupted divine sword sealed in the Sentient River
description: Sealed within the depths of the Sentient River, held down by two separate seals rather than one, as though whoever bound it there didn’t trust a single ward to be enough. The blade itself is dark, almost absorbing the light around it rather than reflecting it, with faint cracks of dim gold light bleeding through along the fuller — like the last remnants of what it used to be before it fell. Even sealed, the water around it never fully settles; the current near it moves like something is still restless beneath the surface. Strangely, the blade doesn’t feel like something purely angelic or purely demonic — whatever corruption twisted it seems to have left behind a blade that belongs fully to neither side. Very effective against an angel or a demon; it can stop the regeneration of both races effectively unless the user releases the effect. A user bound weapon. One of the only ways to kill a Serapharch.

fields.label: Skill — Graceless Edge
fields.value: Cuts through both holy wards and demonic wards equally, treating corrupted and uncorrupted Veyn as the same thing to sever — essentially cutting magic if you have enough Veyn to cut it.

fields.label: Skill — Split Grace
fields.value: Channels both a holy (angelic) and a corrupted (demonic) aura through the blade at the same time, striking with both auras layered into one attack. Dangerous to hold even briefly; causes a force-splitting explosion of the cut area.

fields.label: Location
fields.value: Depths of the Sentient River, under two seals

fields.label: User-bound
fields.value: Binds to the user’s soul — anyone else who tries to use it finds it becomes nothing more than a piece of metal.

name: Virastra, the Ascendant Vow
subtitle: The uncorrupted divine sword, lost in the ruins
description: Lost somewhere in the ruins scattered across the Hidden Realm, no longer in anyone’s possession. Unlike Vireth, its blade is untouched, still holding a clean, steady light along its edge — closer to moonlight than sunlight. Where Vireth feels heavy and restless, Virastra is said to feel almost weightless in the hand, an ease that reflects its uncorrupted nature. Being lost among ruins rather than deliberately sealed, its exact location isn’t guarded the way Vireth’s is — it’s simply forgotten, waiting for someone to stumble upon it rather than seek it out. Extremely effective against demons and halts a demon’s regeneration unless the user releases the effect.

fields.label: Location
fields.value: Lost somewhere in the ruins scattered across the Hidden Realm

name: Solvane, the Hallowed Edge
subtitle: The divine spear still in someone’s possession
description: The only one of the two Divine Weapons still in someone’s possession rather than lost or sealed away. Unlike Vireth’s restless darkness or Virastra’s weightless calm, Solvane carries itself with quiet authority — its head long and narrow, more piercing than cutting, forged for a single decisive strike rather than a prolonged exchange. The metal holds a steady, clean light along its edge, similar in tone to Virastra’s, since neither has ever been corrupted — but where Virastra’s light feels ambient and calm, Solvane’s feels focused, almost gathered to a point, fitting a weapon built to be thrown or thrust with precision rather than swung. Will always return to the owner when thrown. A user bound weapon that can be passed down.

fields.label: Owner
fields.value: Clint Ashborn — the current ruler of the Angel Realm.

fields.label: Notable
fields.value: Always returns to the owner when thrown; user bound weapon that can be passed down.

fields.label: User-bound
fields.value: Binds to the user’s soul — anyone else who tries to use it finds it becomes nothing more than a piece of metal.

name: Aerendrel, the Skybound Wrath
subtitle: The storm-strung bow of the Lethmoor vault
description: A unique divine-adjacent bow, said to have been strung with a fragment of storm itself rather than ordinary sinew or Veyn. Those loosed from it don’t just pierce — they carry a violent surge of raw elemental force (lightning, wind, or pressure), which detonates on impact rather than simply striking true. Unlike a standard Archer’s Veyn-enchanted arrows, which are shaped and controlled, Aerendrel’s power is closer to a contained storm — difficult to fully master, and even harder to wield without some of that raw force spilling back onto the archer themselves. It doesn’t need arrows: the bow forms arrows from the user’s Veyn. Found in the chamber beneath Lethmoor’s throne chair.

fields.label: Location
fields.value: Vault of Lethmoor Kingdom (chamber beneath the throne chair)

fields.label: Note
fields.value: "Sinew" refers to a tendon — the tough, fibrous connective tissue that attaches muscle to bone.

name: Liework’s Fallen Crown
subtitle: The decayed crown of a fallen kingdom
description: Shaped like a twisted ring of black thorned vines rather than a traditional band of gold — more a wreath of dead growth than a symbol of triumph. Wherever the true crown once looked like, this is what remained after the kingdom fell: thorns in place of jewels, black in place of gleaming metal, as if the crown itself decayed alongside the throne it once sat on. Wearing it doesn’t grant strength so much as command — faint traces of the authority its last wearer held still cling to it, enough to lean on an Angelic Aura-style effect, making those weaker than the wearer more inclined to submit, though nowhere near as absolute as a true Serapharch’s presence.

name: Sael’s Luck
subtitle: One critical strike, blocked
description: A luck pendant that blocks a critical/fatal strike that can kill you once, and then breaks.

name: Auralis Ruby
subtitle: The pendant that sealed the MC’s forms
description: A pendant crafted by the MC’s mom (Lisa), who then gave it to Sofia. The pendant has 5 seals to seal the MC’s 5 forms. It seals both of his auras (angelic and demonic), which makes him look human.

name: Agro Totem
subtitle: Summon a storm of monsters
description: A totem made to attract a storm of monsters to it, make all the monsters angry, and boost the power of monsters by 10. For it to work, 2 must be made: the first is set in the monster area, and the other at the desired location — when you infuse Veyn once into the second totem at the designed location, the monsters are drawn there. It can be crafted with blood of a siren, a Lucent Stone, blood of a Veilborn, and a hay doll on a stick.

fields.label: Ingredients
fields.value: Blood of a siren, Lucent Stone, blood of a Veilborn, a hay doll on a stick

name: Jaiden Marlock
subtitle: Main Character — the first Angel-Demon Hybrid
description: A hybrid of an angel and a demon, and as a result became the first hybrid in the world. His parents were the right-hand man of the rulers of the angel and the demon realm, respectively. He was given to his mother’s personal maid, Sofia, along with the Auralis Ruby pendant to seal his auras so he looks human. He then lives in the Human Realm with Sofia.

fields.label: Forms
fields.value: 1st — Normal: looks fully human, no wings, horns, or halo. 2nd — A halo appears above his head and two horns emerge from his forehead, using partial abilities of both an angel and a demon. 3rd — Full angel form: 6 pure feathery white wings and a brightly glowing halo, with the angelic aura. 4th — Full demon form: 6 horns and 6 dark purple feathery wings, with the demonic aura. 5th — True hybrid form: 3 pure white feathery wings on one half and 3 black feathery wings on the other, 6 horns, and a halo split in half floating above his head. Both the angelic and demonic auras surround him at the same time.

fields.label: Parents
fields.value: Lisa (Bloodward demon) and Ordium (Aetherblade Lord Angel)

name: Lisa
subtitle: Bloodward demon — most powerful after the Mordrach
description: She had a child for Ordium, and due to their ranks and positions they could not stay together and were separated to their various Realms: Lisa went to her realm, the Demon Realm, and Ordium went to the Angel Realm. Her rank was Bloodward. She was known to bring cruelty upon people who fight her and is the most powerful demon in the Demon Realm after the Mordrach. After realizing she was pregnant with Jaiden and found his aura very abnormal — carrying both an angelic aura and a demonic aura — she knew he would be killed off and she could not bear it, so she gave the child to her personal maid, not before giving her a ruby pendant called the Auralis Ruby to seal all his auras, which makes him look human.

fields.label: Fate
fields.value: Demoted to Gnash rank and killed by Licent Varak’s men after he reported her relationship with an angel.

name: Ordium
subtitle: Jaiden’s Father — Aetherblade Lord Angel
description: He is an Aetherblade Lord Rank Angel. He fell in love with Lisa — love at first sight. So he left his post and spent the next 9 months with Lisa in a secret place in the Human Realm, since it is large and it would take time for them to be found. They were expecting a child, but unexpectedly they were called back by their rulers… (the document cuts off here)

name: Sofia Marlock
subtitle: Lisa’s personal maid — Jaiden’s guardian
description: Lisa’s personal maid. Lisa gave her the child Jaiden along with the Auralis Ruby pendant to seal his auras. She then left for the Human Realm with Jaiden, where she raised him.

name: Licent Varak
subtitle: Second right-hand man to Tera Morage — the betrayer
description: He is the second right-hand man to Tera Morage in the Demon Realm. He had always hated Lisa for being stronger than him and holding the top Bloodward position, so he was constantly looking for a way to take her power and rank away. When he saw Sofia heading to an unknown location, he tried to follow her but lost track of her. He then saw Lisa meet with an angel. After that, he discovered they had intercourse and that she had become pregnant with a child. He used this information to report her to Tera Morage, which enraged the ruler. As a result, Lisa was demoted to Gnash rank and later killed by his men, which he ordered them to do.

name: Ruby Divina
subtitle: Ruler of the Human Realm (Female)
description: The current ruler of the Human Realm.

name: Tera Morage
subtitle: Ruler of the Demon Realm — Mordrach (Female)
description: The current ruler of the Demon Realm. She has a second right-hand man, Licent Varak, who reported Lisa to her.

name: Clint Ashborn
subtitle: Ruler of the Angel Realm — Serapharch (Male)
description: The current ruler of the Angel Realm.

name: Lisa’s Plot
subtitle: A forbidden love, a hidden child, and a death sentence
description: Lisa (Bloodward demon) and Ordium (Aetherblade Lord Angel) fell in love despite their ranks and positions. Unable to stay together, they were separated to their various realms. After realizing she was pregnant with Jaiden and that his aura carried both an angelic and demonic aura, she knew he would be killed, so she gave the child to her personal maid Sofia, along with the Auralis Ruby pendant to seal all his auras so he looks human. Jaiden then lives in the Human Realm with Sofia.

fields.label: Plot twist
fields.value: As she returned and Sofia left to the Human Realm, Lisa was called to the chamber of the ruler’s throne room of the Demon Realm. Next to Tera Morage (on the throne) was her second right-hand man, Licent Varak, who reported to the ruler that Lisa had intercourse with an angel, which enraged Tera. Lisa was demoted to a Gnash rank and was later killed off by Licent’s men, since he had always hated Lisa.

name: Licent Varak’s Plot
subtitle: Jealousy that cost Lisa her life
description: Licent Varak, second right-hand man to Tera Morage, had always hated Lisa for being stronger than him and holding the top Bloodward position. He was constantly looking for a way to take her power and rank away. He saw Sofia heading to an unknown location, tried to follow her but lost track of her. He then saw Lisa meet with an angel, discovered they had intercourse and that she had become pregnant. He used this information to report her to Tera Morage, which enraged the ruler. As a result, Lisa was demoted to Gnash rank and later killed by his men, which he ordered them to do.

name: Ordium’s Plot
subtitle: Love at first sight — left unfinished
description: Ordium, an Aetherblade Lord Rank Angel, fell in love with Lisa at first sight. He left his post and spent the next 9 months with Lisa in a secret place in the Human Realm, since it is large and it would take time for them to be found. They were expecting a child, but unexpectedly they were called back by their rulers… (the document cuts off here — “but as…”)

name: Jaiden Marlock — Normal
subtitle: First Form of 5 — Jaiden Marlock
description: Looks fully human. No visible wings, horns, or halo.

name: Jaiden Marlock — Halo & Horns
subtitle: Second Form of 5 — Jaiden Marlock
description: A halo appears above his head and two horns emerge from his forehead, using partial abilities of both an angel and a demon.

name: Jaiden Marlock — Full Angel Form
subtitle: Third Form of 5 — Jaiden Marlock
description: 6 pure feathery white wings and a halo that glows brightly on top of his head, along with the angelic aura all angels carry.

name: Jaiden Marlock — Full Demon Form
subtitle: Fourth Form of 5 — Jaiden Marlock
description: 6 horns and 6 dark purple feathery wings, along with the demonic aura all demons carry.

name: Jaiden Marlock — True Hybrid Form
subtitle: Fifth Form of 5 — Jaiden Marlock
description: 3 pure white feathery wings on one half of his body and 3 black feathery wings on the other, 6 horns, and a halo split in half floating above his head. Both the angelic and demonic auras surround him at the same time.

name: Kings Record
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: See a glimpse of someone's memories and past just by touching them.

name: Sixth Sense
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Sharpens all their senses — smell, hearing, sight, and touch — letting them perceive what cannot be seen with the naked eye.

name: Time Reversal
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Reverses time for up to 20 seconds.

name: Chronos Fury
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Summons a barrage of lightning down on a location of their choosing.

name: Will Mastery
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Forms any weapon out of Veyn and can send out air blades to strike from a distance.

name: Holy Rain
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Deals damage to the undead while healing and restoring Veyn to allies.

name: Dignified Presence
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Thickens the surrounding Veyn, making it hard to breathe or move. Uses their own Veyn — the more used, the denser it gets.

name: Angelic Aura (Serapharch)
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Always active. It makes anyone weaker than them want to bow, stripping away the will to oppose them.

name: Holy Flame
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: A signature skill of the Serapharch: flames made from pure holy energy that burn corruption on contact. Unlike Purgatory Flames, which simply burns until released, Holy Flame actively consumes anything tied to corrupted Veyn — demons, undead, or miasma take heavy damage from it, while anything untouched by corruption barely feels it. One of the few things capable of matching Purgatory Flames head-on; the two effectively cancel each other out if they clash directly.

name: God's Index Finger
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Summons a giant golden index finger to suppress an opponent, or shrinks it down into an extension of their own hand.

name: God Chain
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Forms chains of light to lock down an opponent.

name: Holy Grail
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Forms a sun as hot as the real one. Size can be shrunk down to a pebble for more concentrated power, but the larger it is, the weaker and more Veyn-costly it becomes.

name: Warpstep
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Instantly moves anywhere within 6 meters using Veyn.

name: Dawnveil (Serapharch)
subtitle: Serapharch skill
description: Innate to all angels. Lets them blend into any society, hiding their true form and aura. The higher the rank, the more effective the disguise and the less it costs to maintain; the lower the rank, the weaker it is and the more it cuts into their true strength.

name: Skyward Chains
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: A lesser version of God Chain — forms light chains to restrain an opponent, though weaker and easier to break free from.

name: Vanguard's Cry
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: A battle-shout that temporarily boosts the strength and resolve of every angel under their command.

name: Aegis Ward
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Forms a barrier of solidified light and Veyn to block incoming attacks, though holding it drains their own regeneration.

name: Holy Mend
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: A lesser version of Holy Rain — heals allies and damages undead, but with a smaller range and weaker potency.

name: Angelic Aura (Aetherblade)
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Same trait as the Serapharch's, though noticeably weaker.

name: Swiftstep
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: A lesser version of Warpstep — instantly moves anywhere within 3 meters using Veyn.

name: Dawnveil (Aetherblade)
subtitle: Aetherblade Lord Angel skill
description: Same innate ability as all angels, though the disguise holds up a bit weaker under scrutiny.

name: Guiding Light
subtitle: Virtue skill
description: A basic healing touch that closes minor wounds — far weaker than Holy Mend and unable to affect undead.

name: Radiant Strike
subtitle: Virtue skill
description: Their weapon carries a faint holy charge, dealing bonus damage against undead and demons.

name: Formation Discipline
subtitle: Virtue skill
description: Fight best in disciplined groups, gaining strength and defense boost when near other Virtues.

name: Angelic Aura (Virtue)
subtitle: Virtue skill
description: Same trait as the higher ranks, weaker still — more of a passive unease in those nearby than true submission.

name: Dawnveil (Virtue)
subtitle: Virtue skill
description: Same innate ability, though the disguise is rougher and more likely to slip under pressure.

name: Warmth of the Realm
subtitle: Lumen skill
description: A passive, gentle ability to ease minor pain or fear in those nearby. Not a combat skill — it reflects their role as ordinary citizens rather than soldiers.

name: Faint Ward
subtitle: Lumen skill
description: Can form a very weak shield, enough to block a single low-power attack.

name: Angelic Aura (Lumen)
subtitle: Lumen skill
description: The weakest version, barely perceptible to anyone nearby.

name: Dawnveil (Lumen)
subtitle: Lumen skill
description: The weakest version of the disguise, thin enough to break under any real scrutiny — though Lumen already look the most human of any rank, so they rely on it least.

name: Death Scythe
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: A scythe formed from Veyn, enchanted with an instant death attribute. Its destructive power is where their true strength lies.

name: Chain Reaper Scythe
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Their main weapon — a chain scythe controlled purely by will. It can be shrunk down into an accessory for easy carrying.

name: Call of the Dead
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Opens a hell's gate that releases an undead army to fight for them.

name: Dominating Will
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Thickens the Veyn in their surroundings, making it hard for others to breathe or use their own Veyn. Making it denser costs more than their own Veyn.

name: Soul Oath
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Lets them form contracts with anyone, binding the other person's soul until the deal is fulfilled or they choose to release it.

name: Veyn Decomposition (Mordrach)
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Innate to all demons. Lets them turn their Veyn into a toxic miasma that harms humans and can contaminate holy auras or holy energy.

name: Hands of Death
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: An innate ability of high-ranking demons, extremely hard to use so very few demons can. Erases part of a person's memory on touch, though never all of it. Can be blocked for a moment by covering your whole body in Veyn stronger than theirs.

name: Purgatory Flames
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Purple flames that burn a target until they die or the caster releases them. It can be blocked by using a strong Holy Rain.

name: Charm
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Forces someone to do what they want, though it doesn't work on anyone stronger than them and can be resisted. Only female demons have this skill.

name: Soul-Sight
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Lets them see where a person's soul will move next, effectively predicting their next attack. Doesn't work on angels of any rank.

name: Berserk (Mordrach)
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Triggers automatically at low health. Boosts attack power and magic attacks by 20x but sharply reduces reasoning.

name: Demonic Aura (Mordrach)
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Always active. It makes those weaker than you want to bow before you — they would not have the will or strength to oppose you. Can be cloaked by Duskveil.

name: Duskveil (Mordrach)
subtitle: Mordrach skill
description: Innate to all demons. Lets them blend into any society, hiding their true form and aura. At Mordrach rank the disguise passes flawlessly, even under scrutiny, but cuts their true strength by half while active.

name: Blood Chains
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Conjures chains from their own blood infused with Veyn, used to bind, drag, or crush an opponent. The stronger the blood, the stronger the chain.

name: Warcry of Dominion
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: A battle-shout that temporarily boosts the strength and resolve of every demon under their command.

name: Crimson Ward
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Forms a barrier of hardened blood and Veyn to block incoming attacks, though holding it drains their own regeneration.

name: Blood Pact
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: A lesser version of Soul Oath. Can bind a person to a task or promise, but unlike Soul Oath, the pact breaks if the Bloodward dies.

name: Veyn Decomposition (Bloodward)
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Same innate demon ability as the Mordrach, though the miasma they produce is noticeably weaker.

name: Demonic Aura (Bloodward)
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Always active. It makes those weaker than you want to bow before you. Can be cloaked by Duskveil, but only a little.

name: Berserk (Bloodward)
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Same trigger as the Mordrach's, but the boost is smaller — 10x instead of 20x.

name: Duskveil (Bloodward)
subtitle: Bloodward skill
description: Innate to all demons. At Bloodward rank the disguise holds up well, though subtle tells (eyes, a shadow at the wrong angle) could give them away under close or magical scrutiny. Cuts their true strength by roughly 60%.

name: Vitality Surge
subtitle: Scourge skill
description: Burns their own Vitality to temporarily boost physical strength and speed.

name: Rend Claws
subtitle: Scourge skill
description: Their claws are naturally sharp enough to tear through most conventional armor.

name: Pack Tactics
subtitle: Scourge skill
description: Fight best in numbers, gaining strength and defense boost when near another Scourge.

name: Veyn Decomposition (Scourge)
subtitle: Scourge skill
description: Same innate ability, though weak enough that it only irritates humans rather than truly poisoning them. It also causes confusion and loss of direction.

name: Berserk (Scourge)
subtitle: Scourge skill
description: Same trigger, weaker boost — 5x instead of 20x.

name: Demonic Aura (Scourge)
subtitle: Scourge skill
description: Always active. It makes those weaker than you want to bow before you. Their aura is weak.

name: Duskveil (Scourge)
subtitle: Scourge skill
description: Innate to all demons. At Scourge rank the disguise is rougher and less convincing, more likely to slip under stress or in combat. Cuts their true strength by roughly 70%.

name: Binding Contract
subtitle: Gnash skill
description: Their signature ability. Lets them make contracts with anyone; once signed, both parties are bound until the deal is fulfilled.

name: Veyn Decomposition (Gnash)
subtitle: Gnash skill
description: Barely perceptible at this rank — more of an unsettling presence than actual miasma, but it can cause hallucinations.

name: Instinctive Bargaining
subtitle: Gnash skill
description: A natural pull toward making contracts that could raise their rank, though most backfire since Gnash aren't strong enough yet to enforce favorable terms.

name: Demonic Aura (Gnash)
subtitle: Gnash skill
description: Always active. It makes those weaker than you want to bow before you.

name: Duskveil (Gnash)
subtitle: Gnash skill
description: Innate to all demons. At Gnash rank it is the weakest version — thin enough to break under any real scrutiny, though since Gnash already look close to human naturally, they rely on it the least.

name: Graceless Edge
subtitle: Vireth, the Fallen Grace — skill
description: A skill of Vireth, the Fallen Grace. Cuts through both holy wards and demonic wards equally, treating corrupted and uncorrupted Veyn as the same thing to sever — essentially cutting magic if you have enough Veyn to cut it. Where most weapons are either blessed or unholy and struggle against the opposite type, Vireth doesn't distinguish between the two at all.

name: Split Grace
subtitle: Vireth, the Fallen Grace — skill
description: A skill of Vireth, the Fallen Grace. Channels both a holy (angelic) and a corrupted (demonic) aura through the blade at the same time, striking with both auras layered into one attack. For most wielders this is dangerous to hold even briefly, since angelic and demonic energy naturally resist coexisting in the same space, let alone the same blade. As a result it causes a force-splitting explosion of the cut area.

name: Pallantine
subtitle: Light-half elves of the Arubian Forest
description: One of the two types of Elves. They stay in the Arubian Forest, the light half of the Ether Forest. They are used as transport by the Griffen, who live on the highest parts of the mountains.

name: Veilborn
subtitle: Dark-half elves of the Umbrage Forest
description: One of the two types of Elves. They stay in the Umbrage Forest, the dark half of the Ether Forest, and they only trust themselves. Their blood is one of the ingredients required to craft an Agro Totem.

name: Angelic Aura
subtitle: The shared angelic aura - scales with rank
description: Always active. It makes anyone weaker than them want to bow, stripping away the will to oppose them. Each rank has its own version: the higher the rank, the stronger and more oppressive the aura.

name: Dawnveil
subtitle: The innate angelic disguise - scales with rank
description: Innate to all angels. Lets them blend into any society, hiding their true form and aura. The higher the rank, the more effective the disguise and the less it costs to maintain; the lower the rank, the weaker it is and the more it cuts into their true strength.

name: Veyn Decomposition
subtitle: The innate demonic miasma - scales with rank
description: Innate to all demons. Lets them turn their Veyn into a toxic miasma that harms humans and can contaminate holy auras or holy energy. The higher the rank, the stronger and more concentrated the miasma.

name: Berserk
subtitle: The berserk state - scales with rank
description: Triggers automatically at low health. Boosts attack power and magic attacks by a large amount but sharply reduces reasoning. Each rank has its own version with a stronger multiplier.

name: Demonic Aura
subtitle: The shared demonic aura - scales with rank
description: Always active. It makes those weaker than you want to bow before you - they would not have the will or strength to oppose you. Can be cloaked by Duskveil. Each rank has its own version.

name: Head Master of the Academy
subtitle: The only survivor of the Hidden Realm’s creation — takes the MC there
description: The only survivor of the old race that was killed off by the former Human Realm ruler when the Hidden Realm was forcefully created. He is the Head Master of the academy, and he is the character who takes the MC, Jaiden, to the Hidden Realm. His extinct race has no name yet, and neither does the academy.

fields.label: Role
fields.value: Takes the MC to the Hidden Realm; Head Master of the academy.

fields.label: Location
fields.value: Stays in the Human Realm; was only hiding in the Hidden Realm.

name: Academy
subtitle: The unnamed school led by the Head Master of the Academy
description: The school led by the Head Master of the Academy, the sole survivor of the old race killed off by the former Human Realm ruler. Its name has not yet been decided.

name: Dark Moon
subtitle: Hidden and Dangerous group of people
description: A group of people that want domination of the world and want to dominate the Realms

fields.label: Race
fields.value: Can consist of any race from the realms

name: Carin
subtitle: Female Demon trainer
description: she used to serve Lisa and later when she discovered that Lisa had a child with an angel she decided to teach the child about his demon powers. The mc met her when he visited the demon realm

name: Jaiden Marlock Plot
subtitle: Plot for Mc
description: His class is Mage. he has a much higher amount of Veyn than other Angels and Demons. He stays in a small house with Sofia who takes care of him and protects him. Later Sofia took him meet with Carin who then train him to be better at his demonic power. Sofia also trained Jaiden on how to use his angelic powers.

name: Wener Leger
subtitle: Leader of Dark Moon
description: The true leader of the Dark moon clan

fields.label: Disguise
fields.value: Teacher of Swordsmanship class at the academy

name: An Angel Breaking the vow
subtitle: What happens when an angel’s vow shatters
description: The vow breaks when an angel disobeys someone above their rank, or pulls more Veyn than their vow allows to act against an order. Once it breaks, the halo can’t hold the channel steady and shatters, becoming the broken halo Fallen Angels are known for. The wings get affected too — the uncontrolled Veyn surging through them at that moment leaves permanent black spotting on the feathers: some end up with plain black spots, others with black cherry spotting, depending on how much Veyn surged through when it broke.

fields.label: Trigger
fields.value: Disobeying someone above their rank, or pulling more Veyn than the vow allows to act against an order.

fields.label: Result
fields.value: The halo shatters, and the uncontrolled Veyn leaves permanent black or black-cherry spotting on the wings.

name: Crown-less
subtitle: A title for Lisa, the top Bloodward who never wore the crown
description: A title borne by Lisa: she held the highest Bloodward seat, the strongest demon in the Demon Realm after the Mordrach, yet never wore the Mordrach’s crown herself. “Crown-less” names the one who stands just beneath the throne — powerful enough to be feared, but denied the crown, and who ultimately chose her son over the rank.

fields.label: Meaning
fields.value: The one beneath the Mordrach’s crown — second only to the ruler, yet never crowned.

name: Demon of Abundance
subtitle: The overfull one
description: A title borne by Lisa — the strongest demon in the Demon Realm after the Mordrach, whose power overflows beyond a single body.

name: Angel of Sovereignty
subtitle: Supreme authority
description: A title borne by Ordium — supreme authority, the right hand of the Angel Realm’s ruler.

name: Angel of the Vast
subtitle: The Aetherblade’s reach
description: The widest reach beneath the throne, held by the Aetherblade Lord Angel.

name: Demon of the Overflow
subtitle: The Bloodward’s surfeit
description: Power beyond a single vessel — the Bloodward’s surfeit of Veyn.

name: Kael Vornath
subtitle: Demon general of the Demon army
description: Demon general — Demon of the Toll. Exacts a price from every soul that crosses the Demon army’s path.

name: Sythra Kaelis
subtitle: Demon general of the Demon army
description: Demon general — Demon of the Harvest. Reaps what the war sows, and keeps the best of it.

name: Drevos Malak
subtitle: Demon general of the Demon army
description: Demon general — Demon of Silence. Where he walks, battle-cries die in the throat.

name: Nyra Thessan
subtitle: Demon general of the Demon army
description: Demon general — Demon of the Thirst. An endless hunger that no victory has ever slaked.

name: Othrek Veyne
subtitle: Demon general of the Demon army
description: Demon general — Demon of the Hollow. What remains after everything has been taken away.

name: Ilsa Marrek
subtitle: Demon general of the Demon army
description: Demon general — Demon of the Debt. Collects what is owed — in blood, always.

name: Cyrion
subtitle: Angel general of the Angel army
description: Angel general — Angel of the Distant. Guards the far edge of heaven where the host does not march.

name: Serathiel
subtitle: Angel general of the Angel army
description: Angel general — Angel of the Unspent. Her strength never depletes while a drop of Veyn remains.

name: Liora Veyne
subtitle: Angel general of the Angel army
description: Angel general — Angel of the Quiet. The stillness that settles over a field before the host arrives.

name: Thalor Elwin
subtitle: Angel general of the Angel army
description: Angel general — Angel of the Unkept. Keeper of oaths no one remembers, and one he broke himself.

name: Aranweis
subtitle: Angel general of the Angel army
description: Angel general — Angel of the Still. Watches without moving; his vigil never ends.

name: Caedric Auroth
subtitle: Angel general of the Angel army
description: Angel general — Angel of the Long Fall. Fell slowly from grace, and has been falling since.
